# dsh-purge-archived
English | 中文
## English
**Permanently delete archived conversations in DeepSeek Harness — the stored log, the projection cac
he, the archive mark, and the workspace membership.**
DeepSeek Harness deliberately ships no Session deletion: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl
` documents that "logs accumulate under `root` until removed externally; the seam has no deletion AP
I", and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` lists "No Session deletion" as a known limitation. Ar
chiving only sets a mark; the log stays on disk forever. This plugin adds exactly that one missing o
nly sets a mark; the log stays on disk forever. This plugin adds exactly that one missing operation.
### Features
- **Delete permanently…** — a red row at the end of an archived Session's `...` menu, with a confirm

ation dialog.
- **Clean up archived chats** — a first-class sidebar panel (beside Plugins and Automa

tion tasks) listing every archived conversation with its size, last activity, and title.
- **Bulk de

lete** — select any rows, or delete everything in one go.
- **Dangling-entry cleanup** — conversatio
ns whose log files were already deleted by hand still leave an archive mark and workspace membership

behind. They are listed as **No log** and can be cleaned in one click.
- Bilingual UI (English / 简体
中文), theme-token styling, keyboard-accessible dialog.
### What one purge removes
| Artifact | Path |

| Stored log generation(s) | `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<sessionId>/` |
| Projection-cache check

point | `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<sessionId>.json` |
| Archive mark | the reg

istry's durable archive set |
| Workspace membership | every Workspace's `sessionIds` |
Connected Clients drop the row immediately through the ordinary `api-session/removed` notification.
**Safety.** Only two kinds of entry are accepted: an id in the durable archive set, or an id with no
stored log and no live Session (pure registry residue). An ordinary, still-stored, unarchived conve
rsation is always refused. The HTTP routes accept only a same-origin, JSON-bodied `POST`.
### Install
From the Plugins page: sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → type `dsh-purge-archived` → **Install*
om the Plugins page: sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → type `dsh-purge-archived` → **Install**.

A local directory install links the checkout, so the folder must stay in place.
After installing a *new version* of an already-installed plugin, restart DeepSeek Harness once so th
e Host half loads the fresh module, then refresh the page.
### Use
1. **Single conversation** — set the sidebar's view options to **All conversations** or **Archived o

nly** so archived rows are visible, then open a row's `...` menu and pick **Delete permanently…**.
2
. **Bulk** — click **Clean up archived chats** in the sidebar's panel list, select rows (or **Select

all**), then **Delete selected**.
3. **Dangling entries** — the same page lists entries marked **No
log**; **Clean up all N invalid entries** removes just those.
### Compatibility
Verified against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` (V4 session-log generation, Windows desktop). The del
etion path is format-agnostic: it removes the whole Session directory instead of naming a log file,
so later log generations keep working.
Requires the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` client package (part of the standard Web/Desktop
composition) and the Workspace registry on the Host.
### Develop
Plain JavaScript, no build step. `index.js` is the Host half (Cordis plugin), `client.js` is the bro
wser module (`window.__ModuleLoader__`), `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the row, `locale/*.json` carries
the Plugin Manager metadata.
`index.js` exports `removeSessionArtifacts()` — the filesystem layer — so it can be exercised agains
t a temporary DSH home without a running Host.

## 中文
**彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 中已归档的对话 —— 会话日志、投影缓存、归档标记与工作区成员记录一并清除。**
DeepSeek Harness 有意不提供会话删除能力：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 明确写着「日志会在 `root` 下不断累积，直到被
外部删除；该接缝没有删除 API」，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 也把「No Session deletion（不支持删除会话）」列为已知限制。归档只是
打了一个标记，日志文件永远留在磁盘上。这个插件补上的正是这一个缺失的操作。
### 功能

- **永久删除…** —— 已归档会话「…」菜单末尾的一行红色操作，带二次确认对话框。
- **清理已归档对话** —— 侧边栏一级面板（与「插件」「自动化任务」同级），列出每个已归档对话的标题、占

用大小与最近活动时间。
- **批量删除** —— 勾选任意条目，或一次全选删除。
- **无效条目清理** —— 曾被手动删掉日志文件的对话，归档标记与工作区成员记录仍会残留；它们会被标记为「日志已

丢失」，可一键清干净。
- 中英双语界面、跟随主题 token 的样式、可用键盘操作的对话框。
### 兼容性
在 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`（V4 会话日志格式，Windows 桌面端）上验证通过。删除逻辑与日志格式无关：它整目录删除，而不是写死某个日志文件名，因此后续日志格式
ek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`（V4 会话日志格式，Windows 桌面端）上验证通过。删除逻辑与日志格式无关：它整目录删除，而不是写死某个日志文件名，因此后续日志格式代仍可正常工作。
依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 客户端包（标准 Web/桌面组合自带）以及 Host 侧的 Workspace 注册表。
